title: Amma Kanakku
desc: Shanti works as a maid in several homes to give her daughter, Abhinaya, a good life. However, when Abhinaya remains lax in her studies, Shanti decides to join her school to motivate her.

title: Jai Simha
desc: Narasimha, a fiery but kind-hearted mechanic, becomes the guardian of an innocent family. Subsequently, he ends up taking on the ruthless kingpin Kariappan and his violent gang to protect them.

title: Sembi
desc: Sembi and her grandmother, Veerathayi, travel in a bus, along with 24 passengers, who strive to help the duo seek justice for the wrongs done to them.

title: Rangasthalam
desc: A young man suffering from a hearing defect rises up against a corrupt local leader along with the help of his fearless older brother. Together, they defy tyranny in a fight for justice and freedom.

title: Jackpot
desc: Two mischievous grifters stumble upon the secret of a magical vessel from an old lady. Subsequently, they embark on a wild and hilarious adventure to acquire it.

title: Finder -- Project 1
desc: A pair of criminology graduates start a firm to prove the innocence of people wrongly framed and punished for criminal offences.

title: Madhagaja
desc: The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.

title: Gentleman Sathya
desc: Sathyam and Chaitra meet unexpectedly in their pursuit of making quick money. Soon after they fall in love, Sathyam encounters Padmanabham, a criminal on the run from the Indian police.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Sixer
desc: Aadhi, who suffers from night blindness, finds his carefully structured life thrown into disarray after he's mistakenly labelled as the face of a protest movement.

title: Pariyerum Perumal BA.BL
desc: A law student develops a friendship with a girl from another caste. However, things take a turn when men from her family confront him over the relationship.

title: Lucky Man
desc: An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.

title: Naan Sigappu Manithan
desc: After his lover is brutally attacked and left in a coma, Indhiran, who suffers from narcolepsy, becomes a vigilante to take revenge.

title: Saamy 2
desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.

title: Idhu Dhaanda Police
desc: Ramakrishnan, a police constable, is posted as a driver at Elathur women police station. He has to deal with the fiery sub-inspector, Arundhathi Varma, to save his job.
